description: Manage Kit subscribers, tags, forms, sequences, broadcasts, purchases, and email marketing automation data from the terminal.

novel_features.name: Creator Snapshot
novel_features.description: One-call read-only operating snapshot for Kit account, growth, audience, content, webhooks, and broadcast stats.

novel_features.name: Audience Health
novel_features.description: Read-only subscriber status counts, recent growth stats, and largest tags by subscriber count.

novel_features.name: Content Inventory
novel_features.description: Read-only inventory of sequences, sequence emails, snippets, forms, templates, and recent broadcast stats.

novel_features.name: Subscriber Lookup
novel_features.description: Read-only subscriber dossier by email or id with profile, custom fields, tags, attribution, and email stats.

novel_features.name: Sequences Build
novel_features.description: Create a sequence shell and ordered sequence emails from a YAML or JSON file.

novel_features.name: Subscribers Onboard
novel_features.description: Upsert a subscriber, set custom fields, add tags, and enroll in sequences in one flow.

novel_features.name: Purchases Log
novel_features.description: Create a purchase from friendly product flags while computing required money fields explicitly.

novel_features.name: Broadcasts Compose
novel_features.description: Create a draft or scheduled broadcast from Markdown plus YAML front matter.

novel_features.name: Email Templates Apply
novel_features.description: Validate an email template id and apply it to a sequence with a partial sequence update.

novel_features.name: Export
novel_features.description: Drain paginated Kit collections and write JSONL export files.
